summary: Staged access provisioning for international hire with country-specific license constraints
description:
Issue summary:
New hire is joining from India (AP-South) but will be employed under the EU entity and onboarding remotely. HR requests staggered provisioning: initial minimal access for ID verification and payroll setup, then full dev access after equipment arrival and background check completion.

Impact:
- Blocker for scheduled start (2026-03-15) if accounts and required licenses are not provisioned.
- License pool for paid developer tools is constrained under EU contracts; procurement/legal require confirmation before reassigning a license from another seat.

Environment:
- New hire location: Bengaluru, India (ap-south)
- Employment entity: Redwood EU (eu-west)
- Onboarding flow: remote; assets to be shipped from EU stockroom (HS code checks may delay shipment)

Steps/Requested workflow:
1) Create a time-limited identity (Shadow Onboarding) scoped to HR/Payroll groups only (start date +3 days).
2) Approve and reserve an EU-bound paid dev license (temporary hold, 14-day grace) or provide access to a license-light dev VM (hosted).
3) Ship loaner laptop with company image and enterprise LUKS/BitLocker encryption; tracker number pending.
4) After background check & asset received, escalate to full dev group and provision service accounts and GCP project access.

Logs/References:
- HR ticket HR-9981 (offer accepted)
- Procurement request PRQ-5543 (license reallocation)
- EU employment docs attached in HR system (link in Confluence)

Requested by HR for risk-averse staged provisioning and to avoid cross-entity license violations.

investigation_notes:
Summary of findings:
- License SKU 2X-REDWOOD-DEV is in an annual committed pool; reassigning would breach procurement terms without budget sign-off.
- EU stockroom has one loaner device available; shipping to AP-South will require local import paperwork (estimated +3 business days).
- Hosted VM option avoids license reassignment and provides immediate dev environment with restricted network egress; requires VPN and SSO mapping.

Action items raised:
- IT: provision 'onboard-eu-shadow' SSO group and hosted VM (dev-light) with expiry 14 days.
- Asset: prepare loaner with full-disk encryption, serial SN: EU-LNR-2039 reserved, get shipping quote.
- Legal/Procurement: finalize whether license can be purchased or reallocated for this seat within 5 business days.
- Security: supply remote attestation and MDM enrollment instructions to new hire.
resolution_notes:
Interim resolution (2026-03-12):
- Hosted dev VM provisioned (eu-west) and credentials created with 14-day expiry. SSO group 'onboard-eu-shadow' created with HR/payroll-only roles.
- Loaner device EU-LNR-2039 assigned and placed on expedited ship hold; estimated delivery to Bengaluru in 4 business days due to customs paperwork.
- Procurement approved one-time hosted VM allocation to avoid license pool modifications; formal procurement ticket PRQ-5611 created.

Follow-ups (post-onboarding):
- After asset receipt and successful background check, IT to promote identity to 'developer' groups and provision service accounts.
- Asset team to record device handoff and trigger LUKS key escrow into KMS and update inventory.
- Onboarding runbook to be updated with 'international staged access' checklist and legal guidance around license reassignments.
